content_md:
We added Microsoft SharePoint vulnerability CVE-2026-65660 & Mikrotik RouterOS vulnerability CVE-2026-67279 to our KEV Catalog. Visit https:

via X https://go.dhs.gov/Z3Q

CVE-2026-65660.evidence: CISA added the Microsoft SharePoint flaw CVE-2026-65660 to the KEV catalog, which requires evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-67279.evidence: CISA added the MikroTik RouterOS flaw CVE-2026-67279 to the KEV catalog, confirming observed in-the-wild use.
